channel.title: Emil Rühmland
channel.description: Notes from building with AI: generative asset pipelines, LoRAs, and wiring AI into real tools.

item.title: How Not to Build an AI Art Pipeline
item.description: Characters worked for my game. Objects needed animation, placement and scale, and every fix felt like duct tape.

item.title: Bringing the Artist Back into AI Art
item.description: Base models blend millions of styles, so no artist inside them can be paid. A LoRA trained on one commissioned dataset can, but the royalty is still unsolved.

item.title: Transparent Backgrounds for AI Art from a White and a Black Render
item.description: Why background removers fail on AI art, the 1996 matting paper that fixed it, and where it still breaks.
